Behind the Scenes

How a production runs

The same discipline whether the deliverable is a month of videos or a dashboard — and nothing ships without your approval.

I.

The Brief

You send the topic or script, brand name and caption language preference — or the decision the dashboard must support. I confirm scope, package and deadline before payment.

II.

The Build

Videos cut frame-by-frame to the narration with hooks and caption packs; dashboards wired to your real numbers. Progress updates as the batch takes shape — no silent weeks.

III.

The Review

You see the near-final cuts or file and mark what changes. Voice, figures, pacing — one consistent look across the whole run, locked at this stage.

IV.

The Release

Final files delivered in every format the job needs — platform variants, caption packs, print-ready PDFs — on the daily rhythm, ready to publish the same day.

Buyer Questions

Before you order

What do I need to provide to start?

Three things: your topic or script (a finished script is best; a topic list works too), your brand / channel name exactly as it should appear, and your caption language preference — Tamil only, Tamil + English, or Tamil + English + Hindi lines.

That is enough to start production. Logos or photos are optional extras if you want them on screen.

How fast is delivery?

Production runs on a daily rhythm — the same line that ships my own series every day. Basic (8 videos) is delivered as one batch; Standard (20) rolls out in steady batches; Premium (30) is delivered 1 video per day with priority in the queue.

Your exact start date is confirmed in the brief, before payment — freelance slots run alongside a full-time store role, so earlier briefs get earlier dates.

Which platforms are the videos made for?

Every video is vertical 1080×1920, made for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts first, and equally postable to Facebook and X. Standard and Premium include an X-safe re-cut and per-platform caption packs; Premium adds a WhatsApp-ready cut.

What languages do voiceover and captions come in?

Voiceover is Tamil AI narration. Captions and caption packs are Tamil + English by default, with Hindi lines included on Standard and Premium — the mix that reaches the Tamil diaspora audience. On-screen text stays in the series template style you approve at review.

Can I book this as a monthly retainer?

Yes — that is exactly what Premium is: 30 videos, one a day, with a monthly content calendar planned upfront. It suits devotional channels, temples, clinics, real-estate and local businesses that need to show up daily without hiring an editor.

Do you also take dashboard and data work?

Yes — Power BI / Excel dashboards, inventory automation and cash-verification tools are my second service, quoted per project. Pick “Data & Dashboards” in the enquiry builder below and describe what you need to track.
